name: Paper my Shell
description:
Lays a realistic paper texture over the whole screen, so it looks a little more like a printed page and a little less like a glowing panel. Matte blacks, calmer colours and a fine grain give it a softer look that is easier on the eyes.

• Seven papers, from recycled and watercolor to washi and canvas
• Print effects, each with its own switch: ink mottle, matte blacks, print colours, ink spread and light scattering
• Covers every app, the panel and the lock screen; fullscreen games and videos stay untouched
• A brightness setting and a Quick Settings toggle
